title.narrative: Urgent Support to the Royal Medical Services for Enhancing Health and Diagnostic Services in Jordan

description.narrative: In Jordan, the Royal Medical Services (RMS) is a crucial actor in the national health care system. RMS provides medical and humanitarian services on a national and regional level and provides comprehensive health coverage to about 40% of the Jordanian population. The Queen Rania Pediatric Hospital in Amman plays a crucial role in delivering comprehensive and specialized healthcare services to both military and civilian children. Handling advanced and complex cases, the hospital serves as the sole provider of certain essential services in the entire region. Furthermore, the hospital’s location in Jordan’s capital of Amman makes it a prime provider for Syrian refugees, given that the city hosts close to 200,000 refugees, about 30% of the total Syrian refugee population in the country. UNOPS support the pediatric ward of the hospital through the procurement of diagnostic health devices and radiology equipment; specifically, a pediatric MRI machine, as per the needs identified by RMS. \n
